sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, market_ticker AS mkt, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS seg2, split_part(market_ticker,'-',3) AS seg3 FROM paper_trades WHERE NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) = ANY(ARRAY['KXFEDMENTION','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXTRUTHSOCIAL','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION','KXRAIN','KXYTVIEWSHIGH','KXYTVIEWSW','KXEARTHQUAKEM','KXGOOGSHARE','KXHMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXTRUMPACT','KXSPACEXCOUNT'])) SELECT series, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT seg2) AS seg2n, count(DISTINCT seg3) AS seg3n, min(mkt) AS ex1, max(mkt) AS ex2 FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
